mission.title: Ship the S3, GCS, and Azure blob adapters
mission.task: We need three new storage adapters implementing the existing BlobStore interface: one for S3, one for GCS, and one for Azure Blob Storage. Each is a standalone file with no shared implementation beyond the interface they already implement. They can be built and tested completely independently of one another.

candidateNodes.title: S3 adapter
candidateNodes.task: Implement BlobStore for S3 in src/storage/s3Adapter.ts with unit tests.
acceptance: put/get/delete round-trip against a mocked S3 client

candidateNodes.title: GCS adapter
candidateNodes.task: Implement BlobStore for GCS in src/storage/gcsAdapter.ts with unit tests.
acceptance: put/get/delete round-trip against a mocked GCS client

candidateNodes.title: Azure Blob adapter
candidateNodes.task: Implement BlobStore for Azure Blob Storage in src/storage/azureAdapter.ts with unit tests.
acceptance: put/get/delete round-trip against a mocked Azure client
